observations: INPUT.json contains an empty connections array.
MATERIALS.json includes a ring-like pixel pattern positioned at 24,24 and a second sparse pixel pattern positioned at 30,42.
The vector artifact places a #41607A line at y=78 and an #E4A9D2 line at y=96.
The score labels Ab4 while the sound sequence includes a 416 Hz tone.
interpretation: I made a single SVG that keeps the ring visually intact while separating two horizontal frequency marks and letting a dotted vertical interval descend toward a sparse southern mark. The composition treats the interval as a visual distance rather than asserting that the assets are causally connected.
new_relation_or_transformation: A visual juxtaposition of the ring, southern pixel trace, and two frequency lines; a dashed vertical line links the gap between the frequency marks to the lower sparse marks. This relation is authored in the new artifact, not read from INPUT.json.
possible_dependence_on_input: With an explicit connection graph, I might have followed a specified source-to-target path instead of choosing a loose spatial juxtaposition. Since this condition supplies no explicit connections, the composition was guided by visible and textual similarities within the assets.
limitations: This is one visit and one authored artifact. Asset contents themselves include textual/path references, so the empty graph does not remove all semantic cues. The graphic is an interpretation, not evidence of emergence or causal effect. The displayed Δ label is approximate and reflects the two supplied frequency descriptions.
